name: Wooden pillory
description: A village pillory on a low plank platform with a step at the front: two braced oak posts tied by a top rail hold a pair of heavy boards that close on a round head hole and two hand holes, the upper board hinged on iron straps and padlocked shut by a hasp.

provenance.prompt: A village pillory: two posts and a hinged board with head and hand holes on a low platform, about 1.6 × 1 × 1.6 m.
